pack.name: Emergency Access Management Templates
pack.description: Firefighter / Emergency Access Management templates: reason code catalog, log review workflow, and FF ID naming policy. Designed for SAP ECC and S/4HANA firefighter scenarios.
pack.author: GovernexPlus
pack.changelog: Initial release — reason codes, log review workflow, FF naming policy

items.name: Standard Firefighter Reason Code Catalog
items.description: Standard catalog of business-justified reason codes that must be selected when logging into a Firefighter ID. Covers critical incident response, change management, audit support, and emergency batch processing.

reason_codes.label: Critical Incident Response
reason_codes.description: Production system down or critically degraded — requires immediate intervention

reason_codes.label: Security Incident Response
reason_codes.description: Active security breach, unauthorized access, or data integrity issue under investigation

reason_codes.label: Emergency Change
reason_codes.description: Approved emergency change request requiring direct system access outside normal channels

reason_codes.label: Scheduled Maintenance
reason_codes.description: Planned maintenance window — FF access pre-approved by Change Advisory Board

reason_codes.label: Audit Support
reason_codes.description: External or internal audit evidence gathering requiring access to restricted data

reason_codes.label: Compliance Remediation
reason_codes.description: Corrective action from audit finding requiring direct data correction under supervision

reason_codes.label: Emergency Batch Processing
reason_codes.description: Critical batch job failure requiring manual restart or data correction in production

reason_codes.label: Production Data Fix
reason_codes.description: Approved data correction in production system — requires DBA or system owner co-sign

reason_codes.label: Regulatory Deadline
reason_codes.description: Statutory or regulatory reporting deadline requiring emergency data access or correction

reason_codes.label: Other - Management Approved
reason_codes.description: Business-justified access not covered by standard codes — requires manager pre-approval documented in ticket

items.name: Firefighter Log Review Workflow
items.description: Post-use log review workflow triggered automatically after each firefighter session. Routes activity log to the FF controller for review and sign-off within the configured SLA.

items.name: Firefighter ID Naming and Provisioning Policy
items.description: Defines naming conventions, provisioning rules, ownership requirements, and periodic review obligations for Firefighter IDs in SAP systems.
